title.narrative: Provision of life-saving Agriculture and Nutrition-sensitive Assistance to Crisis affected populations in Local Government areas with famine-like situations in Borno State.

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide agriculture assistance to the most vulnerable communities affected by food insecurity and malnutrition in Nigeria. This FAO project supports the production of Tom Brown and distributes it to children under five as well as pregnant and lactating women, establishes community-based integrated fish and homestead vegetable gardening clusters, and distributes rainy season seeds and fertilizers, among other activities. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 49,000 people, including 12,782 women, 29,841 children, and 300 persons with disabilities.
